```{r}
# ---- read only for the electronic supplement -------------------------------

codebook_value <- read_report_input(codebook, report_inputs)
labels <- rh_labels(codebook_value)
diagnostics_additional_value <- diagnostics_value$additional
synthetic_methods_value <- read_report_input(report_synthetic_methods, report_inputs)

# ---- values used in the prose; every one of them is read above --------------
# `report: published: true` in the analysis plan drops the pipeline target
# names from the table notes; with false the notes keep them.
rh_set_report_published(analysis_plan)
options(zm.report_published = TRUE)
ci_pct <- rh_fmt_pct(analysis_plan$regression$ci_level, 0, scale = "proportion")
# One helper is the single source of the interval label.
ci_label <- rh_ci_label(rh_cfg_ci_level(analysis_plan))
# The synthetic preregistration data, for the Methods: the generating design as
# the synthetic-data report summarises it (R/report_synthetic_data.R), from the
# generating file and the latent scores the export was drawn from. Scale names
# and their order come from the codebook.
synthetic_methods <- if (is.null(synthetic_methods_value)) NULL else local({
  truth <- synthetic_methods_value$truth
  design <- synthetic_methods_value$design
  inline <- function(keys) rh_label_inline(keys, labels)
  series <- function(parts) {
    if (length(parts) <= 2L) return(paste(parts, collapse = " and "))
    paste0(paste(parts[-length(parts)], collapse = ", "), ", and ", parts[length(parts)])
  }
  excluded <- synthetic_methods_value$excluded
  attention <- synthetic_methods_value$attention
  n_kept <- synthetic_methods_value$n_kept
  n_divers <- synthetic_methods_value$n_divers
  motive_keys <- as.character(analysis_plan$regression$motives)
  covariate_keys <- as.character(analysis_plan$regression$covariate_keys)
  k <- synthetic_methods_value$n_motives
  covariates <- design$covariates_nonzero
  covariate_word <- c(age = "age", male = "men", income = "income")
  covariate_parts <- vapply(unique(covariates$predictor), function(p) {
    rows <- covariates[covariates$predictor == p, , drop = FALSE]
    paste0(join_words_with_and(rh_fmt(rows$generating)), " for ", covariate_word[[p]], " on ",
           join_words_with_and(inline(rows$outcome)))
  }, character(1))
  loading <- design$loading
  spread <- as.numeric(truth$measurement$spread)
  response <- design$response_range
  cross_loading_text <- if (length(truth$cross_loadings) == 0L) "" else {
    planted <- synthetic_methods_value$cross_loading
    located <- planted$located
    own <- planted$own
    other <- planted$other
    cross <- planted$loading
    r <- planted$correlation
    v <- planted$variance
    v_text <- if (isTRUE(all.equal(cross, loading))) {
      paste0("1 + ", rh_fmt(loading), "^2 + 2 \\cdot ", rh_fmt(loading), "^2\\, r")
    } else {
      paste0("1 + ", rh_fmt(cross), "^2 + 2 \\cdot ", rh_fmt(loading), " \\cdot ", rh_fmt(cross), "\\, r")
    }
    paste0(
      "For one item, ", name_items_in_text(own, located$position, labels), ", a cross-loading was planted: ",
      "it loads on both ", inline(own), " and ", inline(other), ",\n\n",
      "$$\n\\text{item} = \\operatorname{round}\\Bigl(\\text{level} + ", rh_fmt(spread), "\\,",
      "\\frac{", rh_fmt(loading), "\\,\\text{", inline(own), "} + ", rh_fmt(cross), "\\,\\text{", inline(other),
      "} + \\sqrt{1 - ", rh_fmt(loading), "^2}\\, e}{\\sqrt{v}}\\Bigr), \\quad v = ", v_text, "\n$$\n\n",
      "where $r$ = ", rh_fmt(r, 2, bounded = TRUE), " is the correlation of the two scores in the generated ",
      "data. Dividing by $\\sqrt{v}$ gives the item the same spread as the others and a standardised loading of ",
      rh_fmt(planted$standardised_loading, 2, bounded = TRUE), " on each factor.\n"
    )
  }
  list(
    n_categories = rh_fmt_count(synthetic_methods_value$n_categories),
    n_records = rh_fmt_n(truth$n_total),
    n_quota = rh_fmt_n(excluded[["quota_full"]]),
    n_after_quota = rh_fmt_n(synthetic_methods_value$n_after_quota),
    n_excluded_planned = rh_fmt_n(synthetic_methods_value$n_excluded_planned),
    exclusions_planned = series(c(
      paste(rh_fmt_n(excluded[["consent_refused"]]), "refused consent"),
      paste(rh_fmt_n(excluded[["incomplete"]]), "did not finish"),
      paste(rh_fmt_n(excluded[["age_under_18"]]), "were under", rh_fmt_n(analysis_plan$exclusions$min_age)),
      paste(rh_fmt_n(attention), "failed an attention check")
    )),
    n_divers = rh_fmt_n(n_divers),
    divers_min = rh_fmt_n(analysis_plan$exclusions$gender_divers_min_n),
    n_analysis = rh_fmt_n(synthetic_methods_value$n_analysis),
    n_motives = rh_fmt_count(k),
    n_facets = rh_fmt_count(synthetic_methods_value$n_facets),
    n_scales = rh_fmt_count(synthetic_methods_value$n_scales),
    n_items = rh_fmt_n(synthetic_methods_value$n_items),
    motive_r = paste(rh_fmt(design$motive_correlation_range[1], 2, bounded = TRUE), "to",
                     rh_fmt(design$motive_correlation_range[2], 2, bounded = TRUE)),
    residual_r = paste(rh_fmt(design$residual_correlation_range[1], 2, bounded = TRUE), "to",
                       rh_fmt(design$residual_correlation_range[2], 2, bounded = TRUE)),
    formula_motives = paste0("\\beta_{", seq_len(k), "}\\,\\text{", inline(motive_keys), "}", collapse = " + "),
    formula_covariates = paste0("\\beta_{", k + seq_along(covariate_keys), "}\\,\\text{", covariate_keys, "}",
                                collapse = " + "),
    n_coefficients = rh_fmt_n(design$n_coefficients),
    n_zero = rh_fmt_n(design$n_zero),
    coefficients = series(c(
      paste(rh_fmt(design$motive_nonzero_range[1]), "to", rh_fmt(design$motive_nonzero_range[2]),
            "in absolute value for the motives"),
      unname(covariate_parts)
    )),
    loading = rh_fmt(loading),
    spread = rh_fmt(spread),
    levels = paste(rh_fmt(synthetic_methods_value$location_range[1], 1), "to",
                   rh_fmt(synthetic_methods_value$location_range[2], 1)),
    response_min = rh_fmt_n(response[1]),
    response_max = rh_fmt_n(response[2]),
    cross_loading = cross_loading_text
  )
})

sec_link <- function(id) {
  label <- unname(report_section_labels[id])
  if (length(label) != 1L || is.na(label)) {
    stop("No labelled appendix or supplement section has the id ", id, ".")
  }
  paste0("[Section ", label, "](#", id, ")")
}

model_n <- function(outcome) {
  per_outcome <- report_sizes_value$n_regressions_by_outcome
  counts <- rep(report_sizes_value$n_regressions, length(outcome))
  counts[outcome == "network"] <- report_sizes_value$n_network
  matched <- match(outcome, names(per_outcome))
  counts[!is.na(matched)] <- unname(per_outcome[matched[!is.na(matched)]])
  counts
}

fmt_p <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) "—" else if (p < 0.001) "*p* < .001" else paste0("*p* = ", rh_fmt(p, 3, bounded = TRUE))
}
cfa_fit_text <- function(model) {
  r <- s1_value$cfa_sets[s1_value$cfa_sets$model == model, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(r) == 0) return("fit results were unavailable")
  if (!isTRUE(r$converged[1])) return("the model did not converge; its fit indices are not interpreted")
  if (!isTRUE(r$admissible[1])) return("the converged solution was not admissible; its fit indices are not interpreted")
  paste0(
    "χ²(", rh_fmt_n(r$df[1]), ") = ", rh_fmt(r$chisq[1], 2), ", ", fmt_p(r$pvalue[1]),
    ", CFI = ", rh_fmt(r$cfi[1], 3, bounded = TRUE),
    # TLI can exceed one, so it keeps its leading zero (APA).
    ", TLI = ", rh_fmt(r$tli[1], 3),
    ", RMSEA = ", rh_fmt(r$rmsea[1], 3, bounded = TRUE),
    " ", rh_fmt_ci(r$rmsea_lo[1], r$rmsea_hi[1], 3, bounded = TRUE),
    ", SRMR = ", rh_fmt(r$srmr[1], 3, bounded = TRUE)
  )
}
cfa_label <- function(model) {
  r <- s1_value$cfa_sets[s1_value$cfa_sets$model == model, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(r) == 0) "n/a" else as.character(r$label[1])
}
cfa_models <- as.character(s1_value$cfa_sets$model)
cfa_structure_models <- s1_value$cfa_structure_models
cfa_combined_models <- s1_value$cfa_combined_models
# "three factors for ASC, two for UMS-6 (...) and two for DoPL-6 (...)", ASC first
cfa_structure_text <- local({
  rows <- cfa_structure_models[order(cfa_structure_models$set != "asc"), , drop = FALSE]
  set_labels <- vapply(analysis_plan$factor_analysis$sets, function(x) as.character(x$label), character(1))
  names(set_labels) <- vapply(analysis_plan$factor_analysis$sets, function(x) as.character(x$key), character(1))
  parts <- paste0(rh_fmt_count(rows$n_factors), c(" factors for ", rep(" for ", nrow(rows) - 1L)),
                  unname(set_labels[as.character(rows$set)]))
  if (length(parts) <= 1L) return(paste(parts, collapse = ""))
  paste0(paste(parts[-length(parts)], collapse = ", "), " and ", parts[length(parts)])
})

cfa_summary_text <- function(rows, description) {
  facts <- attr(rows, "report_summary")
  first <- if (facts$all_valid && facts$n == 2L) {
    paste0("Both ", description, " converged and were admissible.")
  } else if (facts$all_valid && facts$n > 2L) {
    paste0("All ", rh_fmt_count(facts$n), " ", description, " converged and were admissible.")
  } else {
    paste0(rh_fmt_count(facts$n_valid, capitalize = TRUE), " of the ",
           rh_fmt_count(facts$n), " ", description,
           " converged and were admissible.")
  }
  if (!facts$any_valid) return(first)
  worst <- function(key, direction) {
    x <- facts[[key]]
    if (is.na(x)) return("unavailable")
    rh_fmt(x, 3, bounded = key != "tli")
  }
  paste0(first, " Among these models, minimum CFI = ", worst("cfi", "minimum"),
         ", minimum TLI = ", worst("tli", "minimum"),
         ", maximum RMSEA = ", worst("rmsea", "maximum"),
         " and maximum SRMR = ", worst("srmr", "maximum"), " (for details see Supplement).")
}

# Descriptive statistics: the correlations of the nine scale scores. The
# estimates are posterior medians estimated assuming a correlation exists; the
# Bayes factor sorts each pair into evidence for a correlation, evidence for no
# correlation, or inconclusive. Their Monte Carlo precision is stated in the
# note of the correlation table (describe_correlation_sampling()).
correlation_results_text <- function(correlations) {
  facts <- correlations$report
  if (facts$n_available == 0L) return("The correlations were unavailable.")
  pair_count <- function(n) paste(rh_fmt_count(n), if (n == 1L) "pair" else "pairs")
  n_unavailable <- facts$n_unavailable
  n_present <- facts$n_present
  n_absent <- facts$n_absent
  n_inconclusive <- facts$n_inconclusive
  paste0(
    "Of the ", rh_fmt_count(facts$n_available), " correlations, ",
    rh_fmt_n(facts$n_positive),
    " were credibly positive and ",
    rh_fmt_n(facts$n_negative),
    " credibly negative, ranging from ρ = ",
    rh_fmt(facts$range[1], 2, bounded = TRUE), " to ρ = ",
    rh_fmt(facts$range[2], 2, bounded = TRUE), ". ",
    "The data gave evidence for a correlation for ", pair_count(n_present),
    " and evidence for no correlation for ", pair_count(n_absent), "; for ",
    pair_count(n_inconclusive), " the evidence was inconclusive.",
    if (n_unavailable > 0L) paste0(" ", rh_fmt_count(n_unavailable, capitalize = TRUE),
      if (n_unavailable == 1L) " correlation was unavailable." else " correlations were unavailable.") else ""
  )
}
correlation_prior_text <- function(metadata) {
  scale <- if (isTRUE(all.equal(metadata$rscale, 1 / 3))) {
    "one third (the standard medium setting)"
  } else rh_fmt(metadata$rscale, 4)
  paste0("The prior for a nonzero correlation is a Beta(", paste(format(signif(metadata$prior_beta, 6), trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE), collapse = ", "),
         ") distribution rescaled to [", paste(rh_fmt(metadata$prior_support, 0), collapse = ", "),
         "], with prior scale ", scale, ".")
}
correlation_metadata <- bayesian_correlations_value$metadata
corr_summary_text <- correlation_results_text(bayesian_correlations_value)

# Adjusted associations: the facts come from the RQ1 report targets; the
# sentences below only word them.
join_and <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) <= 1) return(paste(x, collapse = ""))
  paste0(paste(x[-length(x)], collapse = ", "), " and ", x[length(x)])
}
credible_text <- function(outcome) {
  facet <- report_credible_value[report_credible_value$outcome_key %in% outcome, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(facet) == 0L || !isTRUE(facet$interpretable)) {
    return("could not be interpreted because its model did not pass the validity gate; no associations are classified")
  }
  predictors <- facet$predictor[[1]]
  signs <- facet$observed_sign[[1]]
  if (length(predictors) == 0L) return("was not credibly associated with any of the five motives")
  # APA: a statistic carried by a table or figure is not repeated in the prose.
  # The estimate and its interval are in @tbl-associations and
  # @fig-coefficients; the sentence keeps the finding and its direction.
  items <- paste0(rh_label_inline(predictors, labels), " (",
                  ifelse(signs == "+", "positively", "negatively"), ")")
  paste0("was credibly associated with ", join_and(items))
}
n_unclassified_directional <- report_association_counts_value$n_directional_withheld

# Per-cell prior robustness: AP6's language rule applied cell by cell rather
# than as one aggregate count (report_prior_width_robustness()).
n_prior_widths <- report_association_counts_value$n_prior_widths
n_cells <- report_association_counts_value$n_cells
n_prior_comparable <- report_association_counts_value$n_prior_comparable
n_prior_dependent <- report_association_counts_value$n_prior_dependent
prior_robust_text <- if (n_prior_comparable == 0L) {
  paste0(
    "The ", rh_fmt_count(n_prior_widths), " priors could not be compared for any cell, so no classification is ",
    "described as the same under all of them"
  )
} else if (n_prior_comparable < n_cells) {
  paste0(
    "Prior dependence could be assessed for ", rh_fmt_count(n_prior_comparable),
    " of the ", rh_fmt_count(n_cells), " cells: ",
    rh_fmt_count(report_association_counts_value$n_prior_unchanged),
    " retained the same interval-exclusion classification, and ",
    rh_fmt_count(n_prior_dependent), " changed it. The remaining cells could not be compared"
  )
} else if (n_prior_dependent == 0L) {
  paste0(
    "Whether the interval excluded zero was the same for every coefficient under all ",
    rh_fmt_count(n_prior_widths), " priors, so every classification is the same under all of them"
  )
} else {
  paste0(
    "The classification depends on the prior for ", rh_fmt_count(n_prior_dependent),
    if (n_prior_dependent == 1L) " cell; " else " cells; ",
    "the remaining classifications are the same under all ", rh_fmt_count(n_prior_widths), " priors"
  )
}

# Coefficient-level factual answers from the prior-width sweep
# (report_prior_width_changes()). Credibility and direction are kept separate:
# a median can change sign while every interval continues to include zero, and
# a credibility change never replaces the classification under the primary prior.
width_phrase <- function(widths) {
  values <- as.numeric(widths)
  named <- rh_sweep_label(values, analysis_plan)
  named[is.na(named)] <- rh_sweep_sd_label(values[is.na(named)], analysis_plan)
  paste0("the ", join_and(named), if (length(named) == 1L) " prior" else " priors")
}
cell_phrase <- function(changes, i) {
  paste0(rh_label_inline(changes$predictor[i], labels), " → ", rh_label_inline(changes$outcome_key[i], labels))
}
sweep_detail_interpretable <- n_prior_comparable == n_cells
credibility_changes <- report_prior_changes_value[
  report_prior_changes_value$interval_exclusion_stable %in% FALSE, , drop = FALSE]
direction_changes <- report_prior_changes_value[
  report_prior_changes_value$median_direction_stable %in% FALSE, , drop = FALSE]
sweep_credibility_detail_text <- if (!sweep_detail_interpretable) {
  "Coefficient-level credibility comparisons were unavailable because at least one planned fit was missing or did not pass the validity gate."
} else if (nrow(credibility_changes) == 0L) {
  NULL
} else {
  paste(vapply(seq_len(nrow(credibility_changes)), function(i) {
    paste0("For ", cell_phrase(credibility_changes, i), ", the interval excluded zero under ",
           width_phrase(credibility_changes$widths_excluding_zero[[i]]), " but included zero under ",
           width_phrase(credibility_changes$widths_including_zero[[i]]), ".")
  }, character(1)), collapse = " ")
}
sweep_direction_detail_text <- if (!sweep_detail_interpretable) {
  "Coefficient-level direction comparisons were unavailable because at least one planned fit was missing or did not pass the validity gate."
} else if (nrow(direction_changes) == 0L) {
  "No coefficient's posterior median changed direction across the examined prior widths."
} else {
  paste(vapply(seq_len(nrow(direction_changes)), function(i) {
    # Where every interval of the cell includes zero (or every one excludes
    # it), the sentence says so: the sign change of the median is then not a
    # change of the classification.
    excluding <- direction_changes$widths_excluding_zero[[i]]
    including <- direction_changes$widths_including_zero[[i]]
    zero_clause <- if (length(excluding) == 0L && length(including) > 0L) {
      ", while zero lay inside its credible interval under every prior"
    } else if (length(including) == 0L && length(excluding) > 0L) {
      ", while its credible interval excluded zero under every prior"
    } else {
      ""
    }
    paste0("For ", cell_phrase(direction_changes, i), ", the posterior median was positive under ",
           width_phrase(direction_changes$widths_positive_median[[i]]), " and negative under ",
           width_phrase(direction_changes$widths_negative_median[[i]]), zero_clause, ".")
  }, character(1)), collapse = " ")
}

# Motivational organisation of authoritarian orientation (RQ2): the sentences
# word the rows of the joint-regression report (the target report_joint). RQ2a
# compares strength: the absolute coefficient of the
# first-named outcome minus that of the second-named one, the signs compared
# separately (preregistration, RQ2a).
# The joint model names its four outcomes aggression, submission,
# conventionalism and sdo_d; the sentences name them by their codebook label.
rq2_facet_key <- c(aggression = "asc_agg", submission = "asc_sub", conventionalism = "asc_conv", sdo_d = "sdo_dom")
rq2_facet <- stats::setNames(rh_label_inline(unname(rq2_facet_key), labels), names(rq2_facet_key))
rq2_direction_text <- function(outcomes) {
  rows <- rq2_value$credible_directions
  parts <- unlist(lapply(outcomes, function(outcome) lapply(c("positive", "negative"), function(sign) {
    motives <- rows$motive_key[rows$outcome %in% outcome & rows$sign %in% sign]
    if (length(motives) == 0) return(NULL)
    paste0(join_and(rh_label_inline(motives, labels)), if (length(motives) > 1) " were" else " was",
           " credibly ", sign, "ly associated with ", rq2_facet[[outcome]])
  })))
  if (length(parts) == 0) return("No coefficient was credible in direction.")
  rh_capitalise_first_letter(paste0(paste(parts, collapse = "; "), "; the other coefficients were unresolved in direction."))
}
# One sentence per pair of outcomes: the motives with a credible strength
# difference, named by the outcome they are more strongly associated with, and
# the motives whose two coefficients are credible in the same or in opposite
# directions. No subtraction is spelled out; the tables give the numbers.
rq2a_pair_text <- function(rows, first, second, lead) {
  if (!rq2_value$gate_passed) return("")
  motive_names <- function(keys) join_and(rh_label_inline(keys, labels))
  verb <- function(keys) if (length(keys) > 1L) " were" else " was"
  first_name <- rq2_facet[[first]]
  second_name <- rq2_facet[[second]]
  stronger_first <- rows$motive_key[grepl("^credibly stronger ", rows$classification)]
  stronger_second <- rows$motive_key[grepl("^credibly weaker ", rows$classification)]
  unresolved <- rows$motive_key[!grepl("^credibly ", rows$classification)]
  strength <- if (length(stronger_first) + length(stronger_second) == 0L) {
    "no difference in strength was credible"
  } else {
    paste0(
      "the association was credibly stronger ",
      join_and(c(
        if (length(stronger_first)) paste0("with ", first_name, " for ", motive_names(stronger_first)),
        if (length(stronger_second)) paste0("with ", second_name, " for ", motive_names(stronger_second))
      )),
      if (length(unresolved)) paste0(", and the difference in strength was unresolved for ", motive_names(unresolved)) else ""
    )
  }
  same <- rows[rows$direction_comparison %in% "same direction", , drop = FALSE]
  flips <- rows[rows$direction_comparison %in% "sign flip" &
                  (rows$lower > 0 | rows$upper < 0), , drop = FALSE]
  sign_of <- function(key, outcome) {
    hit <- rq2_value$credible_directions$sign[rq2_value$credible_directions$motive_key %in% key &
                                                rq2_value$credible_directions$outcome %in% outcome]
    if (length(hit) == 1L) hit else NA_character_
  }
  direction <- c(
    vapply(c("positive", "negative"), function(sign) {
      keys <- same$motive_key[vapply(same$motive_key, sign_of, "", outcome = first) %in% sign]
      if (length(keys) == 0L) return("")
      paste0(motive_names(keys), verb(keys), " credibly ", sign, "ly associated with both")
    }, ""),
    vapply(flips$motive_key, function(key) {
      paste0(rh_label_inline(key, labels), " was credibly ", sign_of(key, first), "ly associated with ",
             first_name, " but ", sign_of(key, second), "ly with ", second_name, ", a sign flip")
    }, "")
  )
  direction <- direction[nzchar(direction)]
  paste0(
    lead, strength, "; ",
    if (length(direction)) join_and(direction) else "no motive had credible coefficients of the same or of opposite signs for both",
    "."
  )
}
rq2a_comparison_text <- function(comparison) {
  if (!rq2_value$gate_passed) {
    return("No strength difference or direction comparison is classified, because the joint model did not pass its validity gate.")
  }
  d <- rq2_value$differences
  asc <- c("aggression", "submission", "conventionalism")
  keep <- switch(comparison,
    within = d$first_outcome %in% asc & d$second_outcome %in% asc,
    components = d$first_outcome %in% asc & d$second_outcome %in% "sdo_d"
  )
  d <- d[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  pairs <- unique(d[c("first_outcome", "second_outcome")])
  facet_rank <- function(x) match(unname(rq2_facet_key[x]), outcome_keys)
  pairs <- pairs[order(facet_rank(pairs$first_outcome), facet_rank(pairs$second_outcome)), , drop = FALSE]
  texts <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(pairs)), function(i) {
    rows <- d[d$first_outcome == pairs$first_outcome[i] & d$second_outcome == pairs$second_outcome[i], , drop = FALSE]
    lead <- paste0(
      "Between ", rq2_facet[[pairs$first_outcome[i]]], " and ", rq2_facet[[pairs$second_outcome[i]]], ", "
    )
    rq2a_pair_text(rows, pairs$first_outcome[i], pairs$second_outcome[i], lead)
  }, "")
  rh_capitalise_first_letter(paste(texts[nzchar(texts)], collapse = " "))
}
rq2_gate_text <- if (rq2_value$gate_passed) {
  "The joint model passed the same validity gate as the four separate fits."
} else {
  paste0(
    "The joint model did not pass the validity gate (status ",
    rh_gate_status_label(rq2_value$gate_status), "), so interpretation of the joint-model estimates is withheld."
  )
}
# RQ2b: whether the seven residual correlations are credible (AP10), with
# their sizes within ASC, between the ASC facets and SDO-D, and for the ASC
# total with SDO-D.
rq2b_residual_text <- local({
  result <- joint_correlation_changes_value
  rows <- result$summaries
  if (!check_joint_addition_interpretability(result, rows)) {
    return("The residual correlations received no classification, because the joint fit did not pass its validity gate.")
  }
  pair_labels <- c(asc_total = "ASC total", labels)
  facts <- result$report_residuals
  credible <- facts$credible
  total <- facts$total
  with_sdo <- facts$with_sdo
  within <- facts$within
  span <- function(r) {
    paste0("from ", rh_fmt(r[1], 2, bounded = TRUE), " to ", rh_fmt(r[2], 2, bounded = TRUE))
  }
  sizes <- paste0(
    "within ASC they ranged ", span(facts$within_range), ", between the ASC facets and SDO-D ", span(facts$with_sdo_range),
    ", and between the ASC total and SDO-D it was ", rh_fmt(rows$residual_median[total][1], 2, bounded = TRUE), "."
  )
  pairs <- " residual correlations between the authoritarian facets, including the ASC total, were credible"
  if (facts$all_credible) return(paste0("All ", rh_fmt_count(facts$n), pairs, ": ", sizes))
  open <- paste(rh_label_inline(rows$outcome_1[!credible], pair_labels), "–", rh_label_inline(rows$outcome_2[!credible], pair_labels))
  paste0(rh_fmt_count(facts$n_credible, capitalize = TRUE), " of the ", rh_fmt_count(facts$n),
         pairs, "; the interval included zero for ", join_and(open), ". ",
         toupper(substr(sizes, 1, 1)), substring(sizes, 2))
})

# SRQ1, number of factors: per scale and item set, how many of the criteria of
# @appxtbl-factor-criteria suggest the expected number of factors, fewer and
# more. The preregistration names the readings expected, fewer, more and
# conflicting and states no rule for how many criteria must agree, so a
# reading is named only where every available criterion agrees; otherwise the
# counts are printed.
srq1_readings <- s1_value$factor_readings
srq1_readings$label <- ifelse(srq1_readings$is_set,
  rh_lowercase_first_letter(srq1_readings$label), rh_label_inline(srq1_readings$key, labels))

srq1_factor_number_text <- local({
  r <- srq1_readings
  n_criteria <- s1_value$counts$factor_criteria
  # "every single scale and the item sets A and B", or the names
  agreed_names <- function(rows) {
    scales <- rows[!rows$is_set, , drop = FALSE]
    sets <- rows[rows$is_set, , drop = FALSE]
    join_and(c(
      if (nrow(scales) > 0L && nrow(scales) == s1_value$counts$factor_scales) "every single scale"
      else if (nrow(scales) > 0L) join_and(scales$label),
      if (nrow(sets) > 0L) paste0("the item set", if (nrow(sets) > 1L) "s " else " ", join_and(sets$label))
    ))
  }
  unanimous <- function(reading, wording) {
    rows <- r[r$reading == reading, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(rows) == 0L) return(NULL)
    paste0("All ", rh_fmt_count(n_criteria), " criteria suggested ", wording, " for ", agreed_names(rows), ".")
  }
  # "for ASC, seven of nine criteria suggested the expected number of factors
  # and two fewer"
  mixed_rows <- r[r$reading == "mixed", , drop = FALSE]
  mixed <- if (nrow(mixed_rows) == 0L) NULL else paste0(
    "The criteria disagreed in ", rh_fmt_count(s1_value$counts$factor_mixed),
    if (nrow(mixed_rows) == 1L) " case: " else " cases: ",
    paste(vapply(seq_len(nrow(mixed_rows)), function(i) {
      counts <- c(mixed_rows$n_at[i], mixed_rows$n_below[i], mixed_rows$n_above[i])
      wording <- c("the expected number", "fewer", "more")
      keep <- counts > 0L
      parts <- paste(rh_fmt_count(counts[keep]), wording[keep])
      paste0("for ", mixed_rows$label[i], ", ", rh_fmt_count(counts[keep][1]), " of ",
             rh_fmt_count(mixed_rows$n_available[i]), " criteria suggested ", wording[keep][1],
             if (length(parts) > 1L) paste0(" and ", join_and(parts[-1])) else "")
    }, character(1)), collapse = "; "), "."
  )
  unavailable <- if (!any(r$reading == "unavailable")) NULL else paste0(
    "No criterion was available for ", join_and(r$label[r$reading == "unavailable"]), ".")
  paste(c(
    unanimous("expected", "the expected number of factors"),
    unanimous("fewer", "fewer factors than expected"),
    unanimous("more", "more factors than expected"),
    mixed, unavailable
  ), collapse = " ")
})
# SRQ1, item correspondence: the values of the expected solution of each item
# set of several scales (the rows of @appxtbl-efa-correspondence), stated as
# values, with no judgement of a match attached. Loading clarity follows per
# examined solution (srq1_loading_clarity_text).
srq1_correspondence_text <- local({
  overview <- s1_value$correspondence$overview
  expected <- overview[overview$solution == "expected count", , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(expected) == 0L) {
    return("The correspondence of the expected solutions with the intended scales was unavailable")
  }
  value <- function(x) rh_fmt(x, 2, bounded = TRUE)
  # Identical values are one sentence, not a list of repeats; where the sets
  # differ, each is named with its values.
  measures <- c(value(expected$adjusted_rand), value(expected$expected_pair_retention),
                value(expected$empirical_pair_purity))
  if (length(unique(measures)) == 1L) {
    return(paste0(
      "In the expected solution of each of the ", rh_fmt_count(s1_value$counts$expected_correspondence), " item sets, the adjusted Rand ",
      "index, expected-pair retention and empirical-pair purity were all ", measures[[1]],
      if (measures[[1]] == "1.00") ": every factor held the items of exactly one scale" else ""
    ))
  }
  items <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(expected)), function(i) paste0(
    expected$set_label[i], ", ", rh_fmt_count(expected$factors[i]), " factors: adjusted Rand index ",
    value(expected$adjusted_rand[i]), ", expected-pair retention ", value(expected$expected_pair_retention[i]),
    ", empirical-pair purity ", value(expected$empirical_pair_purity[i])
  ), character(1))
  paste0(
    "In the expected solution of each item set, the correspondence between the intended scales and the ",
    "estimated factors was as follows. ", paste(items, collapse = "; ")
  )
})

# S1 measurement in full
s1_answer_text <- local({
  answer <- s1_value$answer
  exceptions <- c(
    if (!answer$reliability_complete) paste0(
      "A reliability coefficient was unavailable for ",
      join_and(rh_label_inline(answer$reliability_missing, labels)), "."
    ),
    if (!answer$cfa_complete) paste0(
      "The single-scale confirmatory model was unavailable, nonconvergent, or inadmissible for ",
      join_and(rh_label_inline(answer$cfa_missing, labels)), "."
    )
  )
  if (length(exceptions) == 0L) "" else paste0(
    sub("\\.$", "", paste(exceptions, collapse = " ")), " (for details see Supplement)."
  )
})


# RQ1 stability: prior sensitivity (the sweep over the three priors) and power
# scaling, each in its own subsection.
sweep_widths_text <- join_and(rh_sweep_sd_label(analysis_plan$priors$slope_sd_sweep, analysis_plan))
prior_width_text <- paste(c(
  paste0(prior_robust_text, "."),
  sweep_credibility_detail_text,
  sweep_direction_detail_text
), collapse = " ")
power_scaling_text <- local({
  answer <- s3_value$answer
  fit_failure_text <- c(
    if (length(answer$failed_fit_models) > 0L) paste0(
      "The original fits for ", join_and(rh_label_inline(answer$failed_fit_models, labels)),
      " failed the validity gate; their power-scaling diagnoses are not interpreted."
    ),
    if (length(answer$unavailable_fit_models) > 0L) paste0(
      "Original-fit validity was unavailable for ", join_and(rh_label_inline(answer$unavailable_fit_models, labels)),
      "; their power-scaling diagnoses are not interpreted."
    )
  )
  failure_parts <- c(
    if (length(answer$failed_models) > 0L) paste0(
      "every prior block of the ", join_and(paste0(rh_label_inline(answer$failed_models, labels), " model"))
    ),
    if (nrow(answer$failed_blocks) > 0L) paste0(
      rh_label_inline(answer$failed_blocks$outcome, labels), " (", answer$failed_blocks$block, ")"
    )
  )
  failure_text <- if (length(failure_parts) == 0L) {
    NULL
  } else {
    paste0("Power-scaling failed for ", join_and(failure_parts), ".")
  }
  n_unreliable <- answer$n_unreliable
  reliability_text <- if (n_unreliable == 0L) NULL else paste0(
    "Importance sampling was unreliable for ", rh_fmt_count(answer$n_unreliable_blocks),
    " and unavailable for ", rh_fmt_count(answer$n_unavailable_blocks),
    " outcome–prior-block combinations; their flags are not interpreted."
  )
  check <- "making the priors or the data slightly more or less influential (power scaling)"
  conflict <- "a possible prior–data conflict"
  powerscale_text <- if (!answer$any_successful) {
    "No reliable power-scaling diagnosis was available"
  } else if (answer$n_flagged == 0L) {
    paste0(rh_capitalise_first_letter(check), " flagged no coefficient and no Bayesian R²")
  } else {
    paste0(
      rh_capitalise_first_letter(check), " flagged ", rh_fmt_count(answer$n_flagged),
      if (answer$n_flagged == 1L) " coefficient" else " distinct coefficients",
      " for ", conflict
    )
  }
  paste(c(fit_failure_text, failure_text, reliability_text, paste0(powerscale_text, " (for details see Supplement).")),
        collapse = " ")
})

# RQ1 stability: the prior and posterior predictive checks, with the features
# outside the simulated range named, and the refit allowing heavier tails.
pp_feature_label <- c(
  mean = "mean", sd = "standard deviation", skew = "skewness",
  kurtosis = "excess kurtosis", min = "minimum", max = "maximum"
)
predictive_check_text <- local({
  answer <- s4_value$answer
  prior_text <- if (!answer$prior_any) {
    "The prior predictive check of the observed response scales was unavailable."
  } else if (answer$prior_all_span) {
    ranges <- s4_value$prior_range
    pct <- function(x) rh_fmt_pct(x, 1, scale = "proportion")
    paste0(
      "In the prior predictive check, between ", pct(ranges$primary_min), " and ",
      pct(ranges$primary_max), " of the answers simulated under the primary prior fell outside the ",
      "response range of ", rh_fmt_n(ranges$response_min), " to ", rh_fmt_n(ranges$response_max),
      ", depending on the facet, and at most ", pct(ranges$gaussian_max),
      " under the permissive prior (for details see Supplement)."
    )
  } else if (length(answer$prior_unavailable_outcomes) > 0L) {
    paste0(
      "The prior predictive check was unavailable for ",
      join_and(unique(rh_label_inline(answer$prior_unavailable_outcomes, labels))), "."
    )
  } else {
    paste0(
      "In the prior predictive check, how far answers simulated from the priors alone covered the response ",
      "scale varied across facets and fits."
    )
  }
  simulated <- paste0("the range of ", ci_pct, " of the data sets simulated from the fitted model")
  posterior_text <- if (!answer$pp_any) {
    "The posterior predictive comparisons were unavailable."
  } else if (answer$n_pp_unavailable > 0L) {
    paste0(
      "The posterior predictive comparisons were unavailable for ",
      rh_fmt_count(answer$n_pp_unavailable),
      if (answer$n_pp_unavailable == 1L) " statistic." else " statistics."
    )
  } else if (answer$n_pp_outside == 0L) {
    paste0("In the posterior predictive check, every observed feature of the scores lay inside ", simulated, ".")
  } else {
    outside <- s4_value$section$outside
    by_facet <- vapply(unique(outside$outcome), function(outcome) {
      rows <- outside[outside$outcome == outcome, , drop = FALSE]
      side <- if (all(rows$above)) "above" else if (!any(rows$above)) "below" else "outside"
      paste0("the ", join_and(unname(pp_feature_label[rows$stat])), " of ",
             rh_label_inline(outcome, labels), " (", side, " that range)")
    }, character(1))
    paste0(
      "In the posterior predictive check, for ", rh_fmt_count(answer$n_pp_outside),
      if (answer$n_pp_outside == 1L) " feature" else " features",
      " of the scores the observed value lay outside ", simulated, ": ",
      join_and(by_facet), "."
    )
  }
  list(prior = prior_text, posterior = paste0(sub("\\.$", "", posterior_text), " (for details see Supplement)."))
})
heavier_tail_text <- local({
  answer <- s4_value$answer
  triggered <- answer$triggered
  refitted <- answer$refitted
  rule <- "the preregistered rule for heavier-than-normal tails"
  refit <- "refitted allowing heavier tails, with Student-t errors"
  text <- if (!answer$tail_any) {
    "The heavier-tail diagnostic was unavailable"
  } else if (length(answer$tail_unavailable_outcomes) > 0L) {
    paste0(
      "The heavier-tail diagnostic was unavailable for ",
      join_and(unique(rh_label_inline(answer$tail_unavailable_outcomes, labels)))
    )
  } else if (length(triggered) == 0L) {
    paste0("No facet met ", rule, ", so no model was ", refit)
  } else if (all(triggered %in% refitted)) {
    rh_capitalise_first_letter(paste0(
      if (length(triggered) == 1L) "only " else "",
      join_and(rh_label_inline(triggered, labels)), " met ", rule,
      if (length(triggered) == 1L) " and was " else " and were ", refit
    ))
  } else {
    paste0(
      "The heavier-tail criterion was met without a completed Student-t refit for ",
      join_and(rh_label_inline(setdiff(triggered, refitted), labels))
    )
  }
  paste0(text, " (for details see Supplement).")
})

# The full-data network against the bagged one (Results, RQ3 stability, and
# supplement S4)
network_agreement_text <- local({
  answer <- s5_value$answer
  total <- answer$n_edges
  changed <- answer$n_changed
  if (!answer$comparison_available) {
    "The comparison between bagged and full-data edge decisions was unavailable."
  } else if (changed == 0L) {
    paste0("The bagged and full-data decisions agreed for all ", rh_fmt_count(total), " edges.")
  } else {
    paste0(
      "The bagged and full-data decisions agreed for ", rh_fmt_n(answer$n_agreed), " of ", rh_fmt_n(total),
      " edges", if (answer$all_disagreements_inconclusive) ", and every disagreement became inconclusive after bagging." else "."
    )
  }
})
s5_answer_text <- local({
  answer <- s5_value$answer
  agreement_text <- network_agreement_text
  stable_text <- if (answer$n_conclusive == 0L) {
    "The bagged result contained no conclusive edge decision"
  } else if (nrow(answer$unstable_edges) > 0L) {
    paste0(
      "Resample stability was unavailable for ",
      join_and(rh_network_edge_label(answer$unstable_edges$node_i, answer$unstable_edges$node_j, labels,
                                     inline = TRUE))
    )
  } else if (answer$n_majority == answer$n_conclusive) {
    "Every conclusive bagged decision crossed its matching threshold in most resamples"
  } else {
    paste0(
      rh_fmt_count(answer$n_majority),
      " of ", rh_fmt_count(answer$n_conclusive),
      " conclusive bagged decisions crossed their matching threshold in most resamples"
    )
  }
  paste(agreement_text, paste0(stable_text, " (for details see Supplement)."))
})

# sampling diagnostics (appendix)
diagnostics_answer_text <- local({
  n_fits <- diagnostics_value$n_fits
  failed <- diagnostics_value$failed
  if (n_fits == 0L) {
    "Sampling diagnostics were unavailable for the listed regression fits (for details see Supplement)."
  } else if (nrow(failed) == 0L) {
    paste0(
      "All ", rh_fmt_count(n_fits),
      " listed regression fits, including every prior-sweep fit, passed each diagnostic: ",
      join_and(diagnostics_value$components),
      " (for details see Supplement)."
    )
  } else {
    failed_components <- vapply(failed$failed_components, function(components) {
      if (length(components) == 0L) "validity-gate status" else join_and(components)
    }, character(1))
    failed_labels <- paste0(
      rh_label_inline(failed$outcome, labels), " (",
      rh_sweep_sd_label(failed$slope_sd, analysis_plan), ", ", failed$family, ": ",
      failed_components, ")"
    )
    paste0(
      rh_fmt_count(diagnostics_value$n_failed), " of ", rh_fmt_count(n_fits),
      " listed regression fits did not pass the validity gate. Failed diagnostics by fit: ",
      join_and(failed_labels), ". Every diagnostic not named for a fit passed there (for details see Supplement)."
    )
  }
})

diagnostic_extrema_text <- function(diagnostics) {
  extreme <- function(key, direction) attr(diagnostics, "report_extrema")[[key]]
  if (nrow(diagnostics) == 0L) return("")
  paste0(
    "Across the listed fits, maximum R̂ was ", rh_fmt(extreme("rhat_max", "maximum"), 3),
    ", minimum bulk ESS was ", rh_fmt_n(extreme("ess_bulk_min", "minimum")),
    ", minimum tail ESS was ", rh_fmt_n(extreme("ess_tail_min", "minimum")),
    " and minimum BFMI was ", rh_fmt(extreme("bfmi_min", "minimum"), 2),
    ". ",
    if (extreme("n_divergent", "maximum") == 0 && extreme("n_treedepth_hits", "maximum") == 0)
      "No fit had a divergent transition or a transition at the maximum tree depth." else paste0(
      "The largest number of divergent transitions in one fit was ", rh_fmt_n(extreme("n_divergent", "maximum")),
      ", and of transitions at the maximum tree depth ", rh_fmt_n(extreme("n_treedepth_hits", "maximum")), ".")
  )
}

# S6 explained variance
s6_answer_text <- local({

# Conditional dependencies
network_bagged_value <- network_value$bagged
network_decisions_value <- network_value$decisions
net_counts <- network_value$counts
# The retained sampler steps, the successful resamples and the edge prior of
# the run: subsetting the bag drops its attributes, so they are read from the
# bag itself. Together they set the largest Bayes factor the bagged network
# can resolve (rh_network_bf()).
network_n_sweeps <- attr(network_bagged_value, "n_sweeps")
network_g_prior <- attr(network_bagged_value, "g_prior")
# The preregistered decision rule, stated with its thresholds (AP10).
bf_include_text <- rh_fmt(analysis_plan$network$bf_include, 0)
bf_exclude_text <- local({
  fraction <- rh_ratio_label(analysis_plan$network$bf_exclude)
  if (is.na(fraction)) rh_fmt(analysis_plan$network$bf_exclude, 2) else fraction
})
# "two were present (A – B; C – D), two absent (E – F) and eight
# inconclusive": the decisions of a set of edges, the present and the absent
# edges named; with `signs`, each present edge with the sign of its weight
# (a weight is named for present edges only).
decisions_text <- function(edges, signs = FALSE) {
  phrase <- function(decision, verb = FALSE) {
    e <- edges[edges$decision %in% decision, , drop = FALSE]
    n <- attr(edges, "decision_counts")[[decision]]
    named <- rh_network_edge_label(e$node_i, e$node_j, labels, inline = TRUE)
    if (signs && decision == "present" && n > 0L) {
      named <- paste0(named, ", ", ifelse(e$weight_bagged > 0, "positive", "negative"))
    }
    paste0(
      if (n == 0L) "none" else rh_fmt_count(n),
      if (verb) (if (n == 1L) " was " else " were ") else " ",
      decision,
      if (n > 0L && decision != "inconclusive") paste0(" (", paste(named, collapse = "; "), ")") else ""
    )
  }
  paste0(phrase("present", verb = TRUE), ", ", phrase("absent"), " and ", phrase("inconclusive"))
}
pair_key <- rh_network_pair_key
# RQ3a: the number of edges between a motive and an authoritarian facet.
n_motive_facet_edges <- network_value$n_motive_facet_edges
autonomy_nodes <- network_decisions_value$autonomy_nodes
security_nodes <- network_decisions_value$security_arousal_nodes
autonomy_text <- join_and(rh_label_inline(autonomy_nodes, labels))
security_text <- join_and(rh_label_inline(security_nodes, labels))
# Main bridge tables: motives by facets, autonomy by security/arousal,
# and ASC facets by SDO-D. All fitted edges remain in the network.
network_motives <- intersect(as.character(analysis_plan$network$node_keys), as.character(analysis_plan$regression$motives))
network_facets <- as.character(analysis_plan$regression$outcomes)
network_asc_facets <- setdiff(network_facets, "sdo_dom")
block_pairs <- function(edges) rh_network_pair_key(edges$node_i, edges$node_j)
rq3a_edges <- network_value$blocks$motive_facet
rq3a_present <- attr(rq3a_edges, "decision_counts")[["present"]]
rq3a_text <- paste0(
  "Of the ", rh_fmt_n(attr(rq3a_edges, "n_edges")), " edges between a motive and an authoritarian facet, ",
  decisions_text(rq3a_edges, signs = TRUE), " (@tbl-network-motive-facet). ",
  if (!isTRUE(network_decisions_value$feasible)) {
    "The bagged network was unavailable, so no edge is classified."
  } else if (rq3a_present == 0L) {
    "No association bridges the motives and the authoritarian facets."
  } else {
    paste0("The ", if (rq3a_present == 1L) "present edge is the association" else "present edges are the associations",
           " that bridge the motives and the authoritarian facets.")
  }
)
# The precision of the large bagged Bayes factors, computed from the resamples
# for the edges of one table.
network_precision_note <- function(edges) {
  rh_network_bf_precision_note(network_bagged_value, network_value$fits, block_pairs(edges), labels,
                               precision = attr(edges, "bf_precision"))
}
network_matrix_note <- function(edges, marks = NULL) {
  rule <- paste0(
    "Each cell: the classification of the edge in the bagged network, with the signed edge weight (partial ",
    "correlation) of a present edge in bold, and below it the bagged Bayes factor BF_bagged. Present at ",
    "BF_bagged ≥ ", rh_fmt_bf(analysis_plan$network$bf_include), " (evidence for a direct association), absent at ",
    "BF_bagged ≤ ", rh_fmt_bf(analysis_plan$network$bf_exclude), " (evidence for none), inconclusive otherwise."
  )
  parts <- c(
    rule,
    rh_network_bf_bound_note(edges$bf_bagged, network_n_sweeps, network_g_prior,
                             attr(network_bagged_value, "n_success_fits"), bounds = attr(edges, "bf_bounds")),
    network_precision_note(edges),
    rh_network_resample_note(analysis_plan, attr(network_bagged_value, "n_success_fits"),
                             attr(network_bagged_value, "n_fits"), attr(network_bagged_value, "feasible")),
    marks
  )
  paste(parts[nzchar(parts)], collapse = " ")
}

# RQ3a: the edges of the autonomy motives with the four facets, and the same
# pairs read beside RQ1, stored as the "autonomy_orientation" subset.
rq3a_autonomy_edges <- network_value$blocks$autonomy_orientation
rq3a_autonomy_decisions_text <- decisions_text(rq3a_autonomy_edges)
# The motive–facet pairs credibly associated in RQ1 (the facts of
# report_credible_associations, as the RQ1 sentences state them) and the
# decision of their edge in the network.
rq1_credible_pairs <- network_value$credible_pairs
rq1_credible_pairs$edge <- rh_network_edge_label(rq1_credible_pairs$motive,
  rq1_credible_pairs$facet, labels, inline = TRUE)

rq3a_autonomy_credible <- rq1_credible_pairs[rq1_credible_pairs$motive %in% autonomy_nodes, , drop = FALSE]
rq3a_autonomy_beside_text <- if (nrow(rq3a_autonomy_credible) == 0L) {
  "No pair of an autonomy motive and a facet was credibly associated in the RQ1 regressions."
} else {
  group_phrase <- function(decision, wording) {
    e <- rq3a_autonomy_credible$edge[rq3a_autonomy_credible$decision %in% decision]
    n <- unname(network_value$autonomy_credible_counts[match(decision, c("present", "absent", "inconclusive", NA_character_))])
    if (length(e) == 0L) return(NULL)
    paste0(rh_fmt_count(n), if (length(e) == 1L) " shares " else " share ", wording,
           " (", paste(e, collapse = "; "), ")")
  }
  parts <- c(
    group_phrase("present", "a present edge"),
    group_phrase("absent", "an absent edge"),
    group_phrase("inconclusive", "an inconclusive edge"),
    group_phrase(NA_character_, "an edge without a decision")
  )
  paste0(
    "Of the ", rh_fmt_count(network_value$n_autonomy_credible),
    " pairs of an autonomy motive and a facet credibly associated in the RQ1 regressions, ",
    join_and(parts), "."
  )
}
# A present edge of the twelve whose pair was not credible in RQ1 is named
# as well; the sentence prints only when there is one.
rq3a_autonomy_present_only <- rq3a_autonomy_edges[
  rq3a_autonomy_edges$decision %in% "present" &
    !pair_key(rq3a_autonomy_edges$node_i, rq3a_autonomy_edges$node_j) %in% pair_key(rq1_credible_pairs$motive, rq1_credible_pairs$facet),
  , drop = FALSE]
rq3a_autonomy_present_only_text <- if (nrow(rq3a_autonomy_present_only) == 0L) "" else paste0(
  " ", rh_fmt_count(network_value$n_autonomy_present_only, capitalize = TRUE),
  if (nrow(rq3a_autonomy_present_only) == 1L) " present edge belongs" else " present edges belong",
  " to a pair that was not credibly associated in RQ1: ",
  paste(rh_network_edge_label(rq3a_autonomy_present_only$node_i, rq3a_autonomy_present_only$node_j, labels, inline = TRUE),
        collapse = "; "), "."
)
# The sign of each autonomy motive's RQ1 coefficient for each facet, shown in
# the autonomy rows of the motive-by-facet table (RQ3a reads the twelve edges
# beside RQ1).
rq1_sign_line <- function(motive, facet) {
  if (!motive %in% autonomy_nodes) return("")
  row <- report_credible_value[report_credible_value$outcome_key %in% facet, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(row) != 1L || !isTRUE(row$interpretable)) return("RQ1 unavailable")
  hit <- match(motive, as.character(row$predictor[[1]]))
  if (is.na(hit)) return("RQ1 unresolved")
  # a true minus sign, as everywhere in the report
  paste("RQ1", sub("^-$", "−", as.character(row$observed_sign[[1]][[hit]])))
}
# RQ3a: the comparison with RQ1 is descriptive (preregistration, RQ3); what
# besides the other facets differs between the two analyses, from the plan and
# the sample sizes.
rq3a_autonomy_caveat_text <- paste0(
  "This reading beside RQ1 is descriptive: besides conditioning on the other authoritarian facets, the network ",
  "leaves out ", join_and(sub("_z$", "", as.character(analysis_plan$regression$covariates))),
  ", measures each association as a ",
  "partial correlation of rank-based normal scores rather than as a regression coefficient",
  if (network_n != joint_n) paste0(", and analyses ", rh_fmt_n(network_n), " cases against the regressions' ",
                                   rh_fmt_n(joint_n)) else "",
  ", so a difference cannot be attributed to the other facets alone."
)
# AP10: a motive credibly associated with a facet in RQ1 whose edge with that
# facet is absent in the network is read as screened off by the remaining
# scales; an inconclusive edge does not establish the absence.
screened_off <- rq1_credible_pairs[rq1_credible_pairs$decision %in% "absent", , drop = FALSE]
screened_off_text <- paste0(
  "A motive credibly associated with a facet in RQ1 whose edge with that facet is classified as absent in the network ",
  "is read as screened off by the remaining network variables, that is, as conditionally independent of that facet given them, and not as ",
  "a contradiction between the analyses (AP10); ",
  if (anyNA(rq1_credible_pairs$decision)) {
    "the network carries no decision for at least one of these pairs, so this reading is withheld."
  } else if (nrow(screened_off) == 0L) {
    "no motive–facet pair is read this way."
  } else {
    paste0("this applies to ", join_and(screened_off$edge), ".")
  }
)

# RQ3b: the classifications and, for present edges, the signs of the six
# edges of the autonomy motives with the security motive (intimacy) and the
# arousal motive (social neophilia), stored as the "autonomy_security_arousal" subset.
rq3b_edges <- network_value$blocks$autonomy_security_arousal
rq3b_decisions_text <- decisions_text(rq3b_edges)
rq3b_decision_of <- function(motive, node) {
  d <- rq3b_edges$decision[pair_key(rq3b_edges$node_i, rq3b_edges$node_j) == pair_key(motive, node)]
  if (length(d) == 0L) NA_character_ else as.character(d[1])
}
rq3b_article <- function(decision) {
  if (is.na(decision)) "an undecided" else if (decision == "present") "a present" else paste0("an ", decision)
}
# "power shares an inconclusive edge with both; ...; achievement shares a
# present edge with security and an inconclusive edge with arousal", a clause
# that continues the sentence before it.
rq3b_motive_text <- paste0(paste(vapply(autonomy_nodes, function(motive) {
  decisions <- vapply(security_nodes, function(node) rq3b_decision_of(motive, node), character(1))
  if (length(unique(decisions)) == 1L) {
    paste0(rh_label_inline(motive, labels), " shares ", rq3b_article(decisions[1]), " edge with both")
  } else {
    paste0(rh_label_inline(motive, labels), " shares ",
           join_and(paste0(vapply(decisions, rq3b_article, character(1)), " edge with ",
                           rh_label_inline(security_nodes, labels))))
  }
}, character(1)), collapse = "; "), ".")
# RQ3b asks whether the autonomy motives are positively associated with the
# arousal motive (social neophilia) and negatively with the security motive
# (intimacy), as the Zürich model proposes (preregistration, RQ3b); the sign
# of each present edge answers it.
rq3b_asked_sign <- c(zm_arousal = "positive", zm_security = "negative")
rq3b_sign_text <- local({
  if (!isTRUE(network_decisions_value$feasible)) return("The bagged network was unavailable, so no sign answers RQ3b.")
  present <- rq3b_edges[rq3b_edges$decision %in% "present", , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(present) == 0L) {
    return("None of these edges was present, so no sign answers RQ3b in this run.")
  }
  edge_sentences <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(present)), function(i) {
    nodes <- c(present$node_i[[i]], present$node_j[[i]])
    motive <- nodes[nodes %in% autonomy_nodes]
    other <- nodes[nodes %in% security_nodes]
    sign <- if (present$weight_bagged[[i]] > 0) "positive" else "negative"
    asked <- unname(rq3b_asked_sign[other])
    paste0(
      "The present edge between ", rh_label_inline(motive, labels), " and ", rh_label_inline(other, labels),
      " was ", sign, " (edge weight ", rh_fmt(present$weight_bagged[[i]], 2, bounded = TRUE), "), ",
      if (identical(sign, asked)) "the direction RQ3b asks about." else paste0(
        "the opposite of the ", asked, " association with ", rh_label_inline(other, labels), " that RQ3b asks about."
      )
    )
  }, character(1))
  without <- security_nodes[!vapply(security_nodes, function(node) {
    any(present$node_i == node | present$node_j == node)
  }, logical(1))]
  paste(c(edge_sentences, if (length(without)) paste0(
    "No edge of ", join_and(rh_label_inline(autonomy_nodes, labels)), " with ",
    join_and(rh_label_inline(without, labels)), " was present."
  )), collapse = " ")
})

# RQ3c: the three ASC–SDO-D edges, and where they differ from the
# residual correlations of RQ2b, whose conditioning set differs.
rq3c_edges <- network_value$blocks$asc_sdo
rq3c_text <- paste0(
  "Of the ", rh_fmt_count(attr(rq3c_edges, "n_edges")), " edges between an ASC facet and SDO-D, ",
  decisions_text(rq3c_edges, signs = TRUE), " (@tbl-network-facets)."
)
rq3c_rq2b_text <- local({
  if (!isTRUE(network_decisions_value$feasible) || !rq2_value$gate_passed) {
    return("The edges cannot be set beside the residual correlations of RQ2b, because the bagged network or the joint model is unavailable.")
  }
  comparison <- network_value$residual_comparison
  first <- comparison$first
  second <- comparison$second
  decision <- comparison$decision
  residual_sign <- comparison$residual_sign
  differs <- comparison$differs
  if (!comparison$any_differs) {
    return("For every ASC–SDO-D pair, the edge here and the interval of its residual correlation in RQ2b point the same way.")
  }
  pairs <- rh_network_edge_label(first[differs %in% TRUE], second[differs %in% TRUE], labels, inline = TRUE)
  one <- length(pairs) == 1L
  rh_capitalise_first_letter(paste0(
    join_and(pairs), if (one) " has a residual correlation whose interval lies " else
      " have residual correlations whose intervals lie ",
    join_and(unique(residual_sign[differs %in% TRUE])), " in RQ2b but ",
    if (all(decision[differs %in% TRUE] == "absent")) (if (one) "an absent edge" else "absent edges") else
      (if (one) "a differently classified edge" else "differently classified edges"),
    " here; because the two analyses hold different variables constant, these results do not contradict ",
    "each other."
  ))
})


likelihood_stability_text <- function(comparison, labels) {
  if (!is.data.frame(comparison) || nrow(comparison) == 0L) return("The likelihood comparison was unavailable.")
  facts <- attr(comparison, "report_summary")
  if (!facts$any_attempted) return("")
  paste0(
    "Of the ", rh_fmt_count(facts$n_attempted), " coefficients with a Student-t refit, ",
    rh_fmt_count(facts$n_valid), " had interpretable comparisons with the Gaussian fit. ",
    if (facts$n_changed > 0L) rh_fmt_count(facts$n_changed, capitalize = TRUE) else "None", " changed whether the interval excludes zero",
    if (facts$n_changed > 0L) paste0(" (", paste(unique(rh_label_inline(facts$changed_outcomes, labels)), collapse = ", "), ")") else "",
    if (facts$n_sign_changed > 0L) paste0("; ", rh_fmt_count(facts$n_sign_changed), " changed the sign of the posterior median.")
    else ", and none changed the sign of its posterior median."
  )
}

network_sampling_text <- local({
  succeeded <- attr(network_bagged_value, "n_success_fits")
  attempted <- attr(network_bagged_value, "n_fits")
  if (is.null(succeeded) || is.null(attempted) || !is.finite(attempted) || attempted == 0) {
    return("The number of successful network resamples was unavailable.")
  }
  paste0(rh_fmt_n(succeeded), " of ", rh_fmt_n(attempted), " network resample fits succeeded (",
         rh_fmt_pct(network_value$sampling_share, 1, scale = "proportion"), "); ",
         rh_fmt_n(network_n_sweeps), " sweeps per fit were retained after burn-in.")
})

# S3 prior sensitivity

n_sweep_widths <- sweep$n_widths

sweep_credibility_text <- if (!isTRUE(sweep_interpretable)) {
  "credibility and sign stability cannot be interpreted because at least one planned fit is missing or did not pass the validity gate"
} else if (sweep$n_interval_changes == 0L) {
  "no cell of the prediction table changed whether its credible interval excludes zero"

         " cells changed whether their credible interval excludes zero")

sweep_sign_text <- if (sweep$n_sign_changes == 0) {
  "the posterior median kept its sign under every width"
} else {
  paste0(
    "the posterior median changed its sign in ", rh_fmt_n(sweep$n_sign_changes), " of the ",
    rh_fmt_n(sweep$n_cells), " cells, ",
    if (sweep$n_sign_changes_credible == 0) {
      "and that estimate was not credible under any of the widths"
    } else {
      paste0(rh_fmt_n(sweep$n_sign_changes_credible), " of them credible under at least one width")
    }
  )
}
powerscale <- s3_value$powerscale
ps_block_text <- paste(rh_pretty_names(powerscale$blocks), collapse = ", ")
n_ps_blocks <- powerscale$n_blocks

# S4 model checks
checks <- s4_value$section
# AP6 attaches an action to the heavy-tail direction only, so the statistics
# outside their band in the other direction are reported and not acted on.
# The statistics in words, as the table of the posterior predictive checks names them.
pp_stat_words <- c(mean = "mean", sd = "standard deviation", min = "minimum", max = "maximum",
                   kurtosis = "excess kurtosis", skew = "skewness")
pp_outside_text <- if (!s4_value$answer$pp_any) {
  "The posterior-predictive comparisons were unavailable."
} else if (nrow(checks$outside) == 0 && s4_value$answer$n_pp_unavailable > 0L) {
  "Among the available comparisons, no observed posterior-predictive statistic fell outside its replicated band."
} else if (nrow(checks$outside) == 0) {
  "No observed posterior-predictive statistic fell outside its replicated band."
} else {
  paste0(
    "The following observed statistics fell outside the range of ", ci_pct, " of the data sets simulated from ",
    "the fitted model: ",
    join_and(paste0(
      "the ", ifelse(checks$outside$stat %in% names(pp_stat_words), unname(pp_stat_words[checks$outside$stat]),
                     checks$outside$stat), " of ",
      rh_label_inline(checks$outside$outcome, labels),
      ifelse(checks$outside$above, " (above it)", " (below it)")
    )), "."
  )
}
if (s4_value$answer$pp_any && s4_value$answer$n_pp_unavailable > 0L) {
  pp_outside_text <- paste0(pp_outside_text, " Comparisons were unavailable for ",
                            rh_fmt_n(s4_value$answer$n_pp_unavailable), " statistics.")
}

# S4 the full-data network against the bagged one
n_opposite <- s5_value$n_opposite
opposite_text <- if (n_opposite == 0) {
  "no edge is called present by one and absent by the other"
} else {
  paste0(rh_fmt_n(n_opposite), " edges are called present by one and absent by the other")
}

# S4 the edge prior: the same edges refitted at every value of the sweep
edge_prior_text <- paste(rh_network_prior_label(attr(s5_value$prior_sweep, "priors")), collapse = ", ")
edge_prior_prereg <- rh_network_prior_label(attr(s5_value$prior_sweep, "g_prior"))
edge_prior_moving <- attr(s5_value$prior_sweep, "unstable_edges")
edge_prior_moving_text <- if (nrow(edge_prior_moving) == 0) {
  "no edge changes its classification across those values"
} else {
  paste0(
    "the classification of ", rh_fmt_n(s5_value$n_prior_unstable),
    if (nrow(edge_prior_moving) == 1) " edge depends on it: " else " edges depends on it: ",
    paste(
      rh_network_edge_label(edge_prior_moving$node_i, edge_prior_moving$node_j, labels, inline = TRUE),
      collapse = "; "
    )
  )
}


# ---- Methods: reading the results, and what this run settles ---------------
# The interval convention, stated once: the central interval and its tails.
# The version of the R package that runs the pipeline.
pipeline_package_version <- as.character(utils::packageVersion("targets"))
reliability_ci_pct <- rh_fmt_pct(analysis_plan$reliability$interval_level, 0, scale = "proportion")
# The settings of this run beside the preregistered ones, which are the full

run_settings_text <- local({
  full <- analysis_plan$profiles$full
  run <- c(analysis_plan$reliability$bootstrap_n, analysis_plan$regression$ess_target,
           analysis_plan$network$B, analysis_plan$network$iter)
  preregistered <- c(full$reliability_bootstrap_n, full$regression_ess_target, full$network_B, full$network_iter)
  if (isTRUE(all(as.numeric(run) == as.numeric(preregistered)))) {
    return(paste0(
      "This run used the preregistered computational settings: ", rh_fmt_n(run[1]),
      " bootstrap resamples for the interval of ω, an effective-sample-size target of ", rh_fmt_n(run[2]),
      " for every regression coefficient, and ", rh_fmt_n(run[3]), " network resamples of ",
      rh_fmt_n(run[4]), " iterations each."
    ))
  }
  paste0(
    "This run used reduced computational settings, so that the whole pipeline finishes in minutes: ",
    rh_fmt_n(run[1]), " instead of the preregistered ", rh_fmt_n(preregistered[1]),
    " bootstrap resamples for the interval of ω; an effective-sample-size target of ", rh_fmt_n(run[2]),
    " instead of ", rh_fmt_n(preregistered[2]), " for every regression coefficient; and ",
    rh_fmt_n(run[3]), " network resamples of ", rh_fmt_n(run[4]), " iterations each instead of ",

    rh_fmt_n(analysis_plan$regression$warmup), " warm-up instead of the preregistered ",
    rh_fmt_n(full$regression_iter_per_chain), " after ", rh_fmt_n(full$regression_warmup), " (AP6)",
    ". The report on the empirical survey data will use the preregistered settings."
  )
})

# RQ1: the differences worth naming are the credible ones in which at least one
# of the two coefficients alone is not credible; a credible pair of credible
# coefficients with opposite signs is credible by construction.
rq1_difference_text <- local({
  d <- rq1_differences_value
  facts <- report_association_counts_value$differences
  if (!facts$interpretable) return("The coefficient differences received no classification, because their fits did not pass the validity gate.")
  predicted <- facts$predicted
  opposite <- facts$opposite
  added <- facts$added
  # one clause per pair of motives, naming the facets it holds for
  pair_key <- paste(added$motive_positive, added$motive_negative)
  named <- vapply(unique(pair_key), function(k) {
    rows <- added[pair_key == k, , drop = FALSE]
    paste0(rh_label_inline(rows$motive_positive[1], labels), " exceeded ", rh_label_inline(rows$motive_negative[1], labels),
           " for ", join_and(rh_label_inline(rows$outcome_key, labels)))
  }, character(1))
  paste0(
    "Of the ", rh_fmt_count(facts$n), " differences between two motives with opposite predicted signs, ",
    rh_fmt_count(facts$n_predicted), if (facts$n_predicted == 1L) " was" else " were", " credible in the predicted direction",
    if (facts$n_opposite > 0L) paste0(" and ", rh_fmt_count(facts$n_opposite), " in the opposite direction") else "",
    if (facts$n_added == 0L) "." else paste0(
      ". In ", rh_fmt_count(facts$n_added), if (facts$n_added == 1L) " of them" else " of them",
      ", at least one of the two coefficients alone was not credible: ", paste(named, collapse = "; "), "."
    ),
    " Every difference is in @appxtbl-rq1-differences."
  )
})
# RQ1: the coefficients whose interval includes zero, read beside the credible

  facts <- report_association_counts_value$partials

                     " (", rh_fmt(top$median, 2, bounded = TRUE), ")")
  paste0(
    "Of the ", rh_fmt_count(facts$n_open), " coefficients whose interval included zero, ",
    if (n_open_overlap == facts$n_open && facts$n_open > 1L) "all" else rh_fmt_count(n_open_overlap),
    if (n_open_overlap == 1L) " belongs" else " belong",
    " to a motive with a credible partial correlation with another motive",
```

# Introduction {#sec-introduction}

This report verifies that the preregistered analysis pipeline works and that
it produces the statistical measures required to answer the research questions
of the preregistration:

- RQ1 — Social motives and authoritarian facet associations: to estimate each
  motive's association with each authoritarian facet, conditional on the other
  motives and demographics.
- RQ2 — Motivational organisation of authoritarian orientation: to compare the
  strength and direction of each motive's associations across facets and
  estimate the associations between facets and between ASC total and SDO-D
  conditional on all social motives and demographics, compare them with their
  joint-model zero-order associations, and compare each motive's association with the
  equal-weight ASC total with its associations with the three ASC facets.
- RQ3 — Conditional organisation of the motive–orientation system: to examine
  which pairs remain associated conditional on every other variable in a
  Bayesian network.
- SRQ1 — Dimensionality and correspondence of item sets of authoritarian
  orientation and social motives: to examine how many dimensions the item sets
  suggest and how well the estimated item groupings correspond to the
  theoretical grouping.

This report presents results from synthetic preregistration data. It will be
the basis for the report in the final manuscript. This approach has two
consequences. First, the numbers in this report are not findings: they show
that the preregistered analyses run and produce the measures the research
questions need. Second, the present Methods and Discussion are shaped to the
synthetic-data approach; the manuscript will not contain them. For the
manuscript, the Results and the tables and figures of the appendix and
supplement will be computed again from the survey responses.

# Methods {#sec-methods}

The analyses are those of the analysis plan of the preregistration (Zehetleitner et al., 2026);
each research question below quotes its method from there. This section describes what belongs to
this run alone: the synthetic data, the software, how to reproduce the results and the settings of
this run.

## Synthetic Preregistration Data {#sec-synthetic-data}

The synthetic preregistration data are artificial survey responses generated
from values set in advance. They have the same format as the empirical survey
data: the questions, the `r synthetic_methods$n_categories` answer categories and
the survey-flow fields of the survey export.

There are `r synthetic_methods$n_records` synthesised participants; for
`r synthetic_methods$n_quota` of them the quota was full. Of the remaining
`r synthetic_methods$n_after_quota`, `r synthetic_methods$n_excluded_planned` are excluded as
planned: `r synthetic_methods$exclusions_planned`. The `r synthetic_methods$n_divers` who gave a
gender-diverse response are excluded too, because fewer than `r synthetic_methods$divers_min` did
so; that leaves `r synthetic_methods$n_analysis` for the analyses.

The `r synthetic_methods$n_motives` motive scores were drawn from a multivariate
normal distribution with correlations from `r synthetic_methods$motive_r`; age,
gender and income were drawn with small correlations to the motives. Each
authoritarian facet depends on the motives and the demographics:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{authoritarian facet} = {} & `r synthetic_methods$formula_motives` \\
& + `r synthetic_methods$formula_covariates` + \varepsilon
\end{aligned}
$$

The residuals $\varepsilon$ of the `r synthetic_methods$n_facets` facets
correlate from `r synthetic_methods$residual_r`. Of the
`r synthetic_methods$n_coefficients` coefficients $\beta$,
`r synthetic_methods$n_zero` are zero; the others are
`r synthetic_methods$coefficients`. The draws were adjusted so that these
correlations and coefficients hold exactly.

Each of the `r synthetic_methods$n_items` items reflects one of the
`r synthetic_methods$n_scales` scores, the `r synthetic_methods$n_motives`
motives and the `r synthetic_methods$n_facets` facets:

$$
\text{item} = \operatorname{round}\bigl(\text{level} + `r synthetic_methods$spread`\,(`r synthetic_methods$loading`\,\text{score} + \sqrt{1 - `r synthetic_methods$loading`^2}\, e)\bigr), \quad \text{limited to } `r synthetic_methods$response_min`\text{–}`r synthetic_methods$response_max`
$$

where level is the scale's typical position on the answer scale
(`r synthetic_methods$levels`) and $e$ is standard normal noise. The factor
structure is thus `r synthetic_methods$n_scales` correlated factors, with each
item loading on exactly one, except the one described next.

`r synthetic_methods$cross_loading`

Problems were planted in the data to test the preregistered rules for handling
such cases: respondents for every exclusion criterion except an age above `r analysis_plan$exclusions$max_age`, missing answers, a
respondent without a gender entry, an item that also loads on a second scale,
and a facet with heavy-tailed residuals.

## Reproducing the Results {#sec-reproduction}

The analysis is organised as a pipeline with the targets package (version
`r pipeline_package_version`). The commands in the repository reproduce the report from saved results, refit the models using saved resampling results, or repeat all analyses and simulations from the prepared data. The renv package records the version of every R package
in a lockfile, so the same package library can be restored. A Docker image
fixes the operating system and the versions of R, CmdStan and Quarto and
installs the locked packages, so the whole analysis runs from a fresh copy of
the repository. The [Code Browser](https://michaelzehetleitner.github.io/social-motives-ideology/preregistration-v1/code-browser.html), generated from the code
itself, shows the pipeline in three
looks: every step in the order in which it runs; the documented settings and
the code of each function a step calls; and the functions those call in turn.

```{r}
)

sample_groups <- sample_rows_value$group
is_party_sympathy <- startsWith(sample_characteristics, "Party sympathy:")
sample_groups[is_party_sympathy] <- sub("^Party sympathy: ?", "", sample_characteristics[is_party_sympathy])

)

translate_party_labels <- is_party_row & sample_groups %in% names(party_labels_en)
sample_groups[translate_party_labels] <- unname(party_labels_en[sample_groups[translate_party_labels]])

unlabelled <- setdiff(sample_groups[is_education], names(edu_labels_en))
if (length(unlabelled) > 0L) {

}

             vapply(seq_along(digits), function(i) rh_fmt(sample_rows_value$sd[[i]], digits[[i]]), ""), ")")
    )
  })
)
show_sample_histograms <- rh_use_gt("auto") && knitr::is_html_output()
```

## Measurement {#sec-measurement}

__Question.__ How consistently do the items of each scale vary together, and
how well do the prespecified factor structures describe the item responses?

__What decides.__ The preregistration attaches no decision: `r rh_prereg_passage(prereg, "Reliability and scale structure analyses are", "are not used for exclusions")` (AP4).

### Internal Consistency

__`r results_label`__ How consistently the items of each of the
`r rh_fmt_count(n_scales)` scales vary together is shown in @tbl-reliability:
McDonald's ω total with its `r reliability_ci_pct` bootstrap confidence
interval, and Cronbach's α. Cronbach's α also stands with its bootstrap
confidence interval. `r alpha_only_text` `r omega_interval_text`

```{r}
#| label: tbl-reliability
#| tbl-cap: "Internal consistency of the nine scales."
rel <- report_reliability_value
# Each coefficient with its interval in one cell; the interval of α stands
# beside it.
rel_rows <- tibble::tibble(
  scale = rh_label(rel$scale_key, labels),
  k = rel$n_items,
  omega = ifelse(rel$reported_coefficient == "omega",
                 rh_fmt_est_ci(rel$omega, rel$reported_interval_lower, rel$reported_interval_upper, 2, bounded = TRUE),
                 "—"),
  alpha = rh_fmt_est_ci(rel$alpha, rel$alpha_interval_lower, rel$alpha_interval_upper, 2, bounded = TRUE),
  interval = dplyr::case_when(
    rel$reported_interval_source == "omega_bootstrap" ~ "bootstrap of ω",
    rel$reported_interval_source == "unavailable_omega_bootstrap" ~ "ω interval unavailable",
    rel$reported_interval_source == "alpha_fallback_omega_model_failed" ~ "α interval (ω model did not fit)",
    TRUE ~ "unavailable"
  )
)
if (length(unique(rel_rows$interval)) < 2L) rel_rows$interval <- NULL
rh_table(
  rel_rows,
  col_labels = c(scale = "Scale", k = "Items", omega = paste0("ω [", reliability_ci_pct, " confidence interval]"),
                 alpha = paste0("α [", reliability_ci_pct, " confidence interval]"),
                 interval = "Reported interval")[names(rel_rows)],
  source_note = paste0(
    "ω = McDonald's omega total; α = Cronbach's alpha; each with its ", reliability_ci_pct,
    " percentile bootstrap confidence interval.",
    if (n_omega_without_interval > 0) paste0(" ω is reported without an interval when fewer than ",
      rh_fmt_pct(analysis_plan$reliability$omega_interval_min_success, 0, scale = "proportion"),
      " of its bootstrap estimates are finite, or its interval is unavailable. α retains its own interval.") else "",
    if (n_alpha_only > 0) " An em dash marks an unavailable omega estimate; α is reported instead." else ""
  )
)
```

### Confirmatory Factor Analyses {#sec-cfa}

Each of the `r rh_fmt_count(n_scales)` scales was first fitted as one factor.

developed for this study, is the only scale without subscales.

subscale structure proposed in the development papers was fitted:

### Associations That Remain Conditional on All Other Scores (RQ3) {#sec-network-edges}

__`r results_label`__ Of the `r rh_fmt_n(network_value$counts_total)` possible edges,
`r rh_fmt_count(net_counts[["present"]])` were classified as present,
`r rh_fmt_count(net_counts[["absent"]])` absent and
`r rh_fmt_count(net_counts[["inconclusive"]])` inconclusive (@fig-network).
An edge is a direct association: the association between two
scores that remains when the other seven are held constant; it is not a causal
path. Present means evidence for a direct association, absent evidence for none,
that is, for conditional independence, and inconclusive that the data do not
decide between the two.
The tables below organise the main results into three set comparisons:
 social motives with authoritarian facets (RQ3a), autonomy motives with security
and arousal (RQ3b), and ASC facets with SDO-D (RQ3c). Each cell gives the
classification, the edge weight of a present edge, and its bagged Bayes factor.
The variation across resamples for every edge is shown in
@appxfig-network-stability. @fig-network shows the full network.

```{r}
#| label: fig-network
#| fig-cap: "Network of conditional associations among the five social motives and the four authoritarian facets. Edge width illustrates the estimated weight."
rh_network_plot(
  network_value$matrices,
  labels = labels,
  groups = list(Motive = analysis_plan$regression$motives, `Authoritarian facet` = analysis_plan$regression$outcomes)
)
```

### Associations Between Motives and Facets (RQ3a) {#sec-network-bridges}

__Research question.__ `r rh_prereg_question(prereg, "RQ3a")`

__Statistical method.__ The method quoted in @sec-network.

__What decides.__ The rule quoted in @sec-network.

__`r results_label`__ `r rq3a_text` @tbl-network-motive-facet answers which motive–facet pairs
remain associated once all other scores are held constant, and with which
sign. Its autonomy rows also show the corresponding RQ1 results for descriptive comparison.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-network-motive-facet
#| tbl-cap: "Bagged network: classification, edge weight and bagged Bayes factor of every edge between a motive and an authoritarian facet."
rh_network_matrix_table(
  network_bagged_value, rows = network_motives, columns = network_facets, labels = labels,
  row_title = "Motive", row_marks = stats::setNames(rep("a", length(autonomy_nodes)), autonomy_nodes),
  cell_lines = rq1_sign_line,
  note = network_matrix_note(rq3a_edges, marks = paste0(
    "<sup>a</sup> Autonomy motive: the last line gives its coefficient for that facet in RQ1, ",
    "credibly positive (+) or negative (−) or unresolved."
```

#### Comparison With the Full-Data Network {#sec-network-comparison}

The bagged network is the preregistered answer. The network fitted once to the
whole sample, the full-data network, shows which edge decisions depend on this
particular sample: an edge whose classification differs between the two has
evidence that depends on which respondents happen to be in the sample. The
comparison is descriptive and changes no classification.

The full-data network was also refitted with the prior inclusion probability of
every edge set to `r edge_prior_text` in turn; `r edge_prior_moving_text`

not the bagged network, whose preregistered classifications use
`r edge_prior_prereg`.

# Discussion {#sec-discussion}

`r pipeline_check_text`

The social-neophilia scale is an unpublished scale developed for this study; no
separate psychometric validation was conducted before the survey
(preregistration, M13). This report describes its reliability and factor
structure, which does not validate it.

## A2 Bayesian Multiple Regressions (RQ1) {#sec-appendix-regressions .unnumbered}

Explained variance of each facet in the regressions with the preregistered prior.
